summary: Handles race completion for a driver. Triggers per-driver race commentary, then (when the driver has not finished and qualifying DSQ is disabled) advances the game action state machine to post-race state 5, transitions the session state, and conditionally switches to menu mode based on the player vehicle's finish state, a timing expression and the session mode. Finally dispatches in-race event 19 when the driver finish flag is 1. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Trigger per-driver race commentary for the finishing driver.
Proceed only when the driver's finished flag (a2[3250]) is clear and the qualifying DSQ switch (dword_7CE814) is clear.
Advance the game action state machine at dword_5EA510 to post-race state 5 with the parameter 1.
Transition the session state machine to state 1.
When the driver's finish flag (a2[4120]) is not 1, evaluate the menu-mode condition on the player vehicle.
Locate the player vehicle slot via sub_4D1B50(0) into the vehicle array at unk_5EC6D8 using the array stride.

Switch to menu mode when the vehicle finish flag is 1, the timing expression (vehicle float at index 4142 plus flt_8ACF90 minus dbl_8AFEA0) exceeds 60.0, and the session mode (dword_8AD298) is not 19.
Switch the session to menu/mode select.
When the driver finish flag (a2[4120]) equals 1, dispatch the in-race event for the race winner.
